edges.reason: Constructor writes maxSupply from _maxSupply.
Constructor stores proxyRegistryAddress.
Constructor stores safPriceLifetime.
Constructor seeds safPriceTimestamp from block.timestamp.
mintAlto branches on block.timestamp - safPriceTimestamp, allowing miner timestamp influence over price.
random() mixes block.timestamp into entropy, enabling timestamp manipulation.
mintAlto requires saleIsActive before minting.
mintAlto reads safPrice for the payment requirement.
mintAlto updates nextSafPrice during price refresh.
_safeMint in mintAlto invokes onERC721Received on the caller, permitting reentrant minting.
mintAlto mints to msg.sender and attributes payment to it.
_safeMint in mintAltoCap invokes onERC721Received on the caller, permitting reentrancy.
mintAltoCap requires saleIsActive.
mintAltoCap mints to msg.sender and charges msg.value.
airdrop loop calls _safeMint to a derived address, executing receiver code during iteration.
airdrop bounds the loop by totalSupply() < maxSupply.
giveaway calls _safeMint to giveOwner, executing receiver code.
withdrawAlto performs an external value transfer to msg.sender before the community payout, with no state update ordering guard.
withdrawAlto sends funds to msg.sender.
withdrawAlto pays the second share to backToCommunity().
giveOwner is the mint recipient in giveaway.
_amount flows into the supply increase.
increaseMaxSupply performs plain maxSupply += _amount with no overflow check.
maxSupply is mutated by an unchecked addition.
owner parameter is used for the proxy registry lookup and super call.
operator parameter is compared against the proxy result.
proxyRegistryAddress is used to build the ProxyRegistry lookup.
isApprovedForAll performs an external registry call to whitelist the proxy.
provenanceHash is written by setProvenanceHash.
setProvenanceHash updates ALTO_PROVENANCE.
baseURI parameter is forwarded to _setBaseURI.
_step is stored into priceStep.
updatePriceStep writes priceStep.
timeInSeconds is stored into safPriceLifetime.
changeTimer writes safPriceLifetime.
flipSaleState negates saleIsActive.
getPrice reads priceStep.
getPrice clamps the result at priceCap.
backToCommunity consumes the random() output.
index is used to fetch the owner in backToCommunity.
share drives both transfers in withdrawAlto.
_maxSupply initializes maxSupply in the constructor.
_proxyRegistryAddress initializes proxyRegistryAddress.
_safPriceLifetime initializes safPriceLifetime.
_name is passed to the ERC721 constructor.
_symbol is passed to the ERC721 constructor.
numberOfNfts bounds the mint loop and price multiplication.
numberOfNfts bounds the mint loop and cap price check.
Loop counter i drives the mintAlto loop.
mintIndex is the token id minted in mintAlto.
Loop counter i drives the mintAltoCap loop.
mintIndex is the token id minted in mintAltoCap.
_dist bounds the airdrop loop.
Loop counter i drives the airdrop loop.
mintIndex is the token id minted in airdrop.
_msgSender falls back to msg.sender via ContextMixin.
withdrawAlto authorization depends on msg.sender == owner.
increaseMaxSupply authorization depends on msg.sender == owner.
flipSaleState authorization depends on msg.sender == owner.

normalization_plan.reason: Local constructor string only used to initialize ERC721 name; fold into the constructor core node.
Constructor symbol parameter has no independent semantics beyond constructor initialization.
Parameter flows only into the maxSupply assignment inside the constructor.
Parameter is consumed solely by the proxyRegistryAddress assignment.
Parameter is consumed solely by the safPriceLifetime assignment.
Mint count parameter exists only as input to mintAlto bounds and pricing.
Mint count parameter exists only as input to mintAltoCap bounds and cap pricing.
Owner parameter is only meaningful inside the approval lookup.
Operator parameter is only compared inside the approval lookup.
Amount parameter only feeds the maxSupply increment.
Recipient parameter is only used as the giveaway mint target.
Distribution count only controls the airdrop loop bound.
Hash parameter is stored directly by the setter.
URI parameter is forwarded directly to _setBaseURI.
Step parameter is written straight into priceStep.
Duration parameter is written straight into safPriceLifetime.
